# Pete A. Kennedy

> Keynote speaker, talent and life coach and executive facilitator based in Sunrise, Florida. Founder of Your Talents Matters, creator of the T.A.L.E.N.T. Framework and author of the international best seller When a Man Loves. 25+ years across corporate, education, faith based, government and nonprofit settings.

## Results
- 500+ professionals developed, 95% rating their experience positive
- 150+ leaders trained, 20% faster time to proficiency
- Leadership Journey 101 at VISTA: 81% participation, 95% rated it relevant and effective
- 15+ internal leaders promoted at Spirit Airlines within 12 months

## Services
Keynote speaking, leadership development programs, executive facilitation, talent and life coaching (CliftonStrengths and DISC). Fees are discussed per engagement on an Alignment Call.
